asp_identity.name: Vocence
asp_identity.description: Decentralized voice AI: speech, transcription, cloning, voice design, dubbing, denoise.

services.name: Text to Speech
services.description: Synthesize natural speech from text using a built-in Vocence voice. Returns an audio URL.

services.name: Speech to Text
services.description: Transcribe spoken audio to text. Accepts an audio URL.

services.name: Voice Design
services.description: Generate a brand-new voice from a text description and speak a line in it. Returns a preview audio URL.

services.name: Voice Cloning
services.description: Clone the voice from a short reference clip and make it say new text. You must hold the rights/consent for the reference voice.

services.name: Noise Remover
services.description: Remove background noise from audio while preserving speech. Accepts an audio URL.

services.name: Video Dubbing
services.description: Translate a video into another language in the original speaker's voice, optionally lip-synced. Metered: $0.60 per minute of source video per language ($2.40/min with lip-sync); the listed fee is the 1-minute base rate and the exact amount is quoted in each x402 challenge. Async: the paid call returns a job_id polled for free at GET /okx/tools/vocence_video_dub/jobs/{job_id}.
